methodologyNotes: Specs sourced from manufacturer product pages (razer.com, corsair.com, hermanmiller.com/store, steelcase.com, noblechairs.com/en-us, noblechairs.eu, secretlab.co) and verified secondary sources (chairsfx.com 4-year Titan Evo review, chairsfx.com Kaiser 4 vs Titan comparison, chairsfx.com DXRacer Formula review, chairsfx.com Herman Miller Embody review, dxracer.com Master Series page, gamerant.com best gaming chairs). Weight capacity in lbs. Recline in degrees (range min-max). max_height_in = maximum seat-pan height above floor in inches (from gas-lift top position). Numbers stored unit-free. Booleans for lumbar_builtin (true = integrated adjustable lumbar; false = removable pillow). armrests field = dimension count (1D/2D/3D/4D/5D/6D). priceUsd = US MSRP for base/standard config at time of research. null beats any guess. All sources accessed 2026-06-15.

products.name: Secretlab Titan Evo

Starting price $549 reflects S/M SoftWeave base; current S/M ~$549-$579.

products.provenance: CORRECTION (verifier): the original entry conflated the standard Branch Ergonomic Chair with the higher-spec Branch Ergonomic Chair PRO. OfficeChairsUSA spec sheet + branchfurniture.com confirm the STANDARD chair: $359 US (not $499 — that is the Pro), 275 lbs weight capacity, 7-year warranty (not 5), 3D removable armrests (not 4D — 5D belongs to the Pro), double-layered mesh backrest (no leather seat option exists on the standard chair), seat height 17-21 inches (max ~21), removable/non-adjustable firm lumbar (lumbar_builtin set false — only the Pro has adjustable lumbar).
